pr_title: ADR-0112 wave-A: webhook-receiver kernel + app (HMAC + dedup + router)
summary: F7 security review for PR #7: reviewed webhook HMAC, secret loading, routing, and replay behavior; 3 actionable findings, highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: HMAC verification only runs when a secret is present, and startup retries without the secret when the secret file is missing. A production misconfiguration therefore accepts unsigned webhooks instead of failing closed.
findings.remediation: Make a missing secret fatal unless an explicit local-only simulate/dev mode is active; in server mode require a loaded SecretReference and reject every delivery when the secret cannot be resolved.

findings.issue: The receiver checks an in-memory delivery log but the HTTP path does not append accepted deliveries to durable storage. A repeated GitHub delivery ID remains first-delivery unless it was already in the startup log, so replay/dedup protection is not effective.
findings.remediation: Atomically append the accepted/routing-failed outcome before returning success, fsync or transactional-write the delivery log, and add a regression proving a second delivery with the same ID is deduplicated after the first accepted request.

findings.issue: A routed event returns 202 Accepted with an agent name, but PR #7 does not durably enqueue or invoke that agent. Security automation can appear accepted while no downstream review/fix/promotion action happened.
findings.remediation: Persist a dispatch request or invoke the dispatcher seam synchronously; record agent_invocation_failed outcomes when enqueue/invocation fails.
